nodes.name: Anthropic
nodes.description: Anthropic is an AI safety company founded in 2021 by former OpenAI researchers. They develop Claude AI models and focus on AI safety research and alignment.

nodes.name: OpenAI
nodes.description: OpenAI is an AI research organization founded in 2015, developer of GPT-4, ChatGPT, and DALL-E. Originally a nonprofit, it became a capped-profit company with massive Microsoft backing.

nodes.name: Google DeepMind
nodes.description: Google DeepMind is Google's primary AI research division, formed by merging Google Brain and DeepMind. They develop Gemini models and pioneered AlphaGo and AlphaFold.

nodes.name: Meta AI
nodes.description: Meta AI is the AI research division of Meta Platforms. They are known for open-source AI contributions including the Llama model family and PyTorch framework.

nodes.name: Mistral AI
nodes.description: Mistral AI is a French AI startup founded in 2023 by former DeepMind and Meta researchers. They develop efficient open-source and commercial language models.

nodes.name: Cohere
nodes.description: Cohere is a Canadian AI company focused on enterprise NLP solutions. They develop Command R models optimized for retrieval-augmented generation and business applications.

nodes.name: Hugging Face
nodes.description: Hugging Face is an AI platform and community hub for sharing machine learning models, datasets, and demos. They host over 500,000 models and are the GitHub of AI.

nodes.name: Microsoft
nodes.description: Microsoft is a global technology company and the primary strategic investor in OpenAI with over $13 billion committed. They integrate OpenAI models into Azure, Office 365, and GitHub Copilot.

nodes.name: Google
nodes.description: Google (Alphabet) is a technology giant and parent company of Google DeepMind. They have invested $2 billion in Anthropic and provide cloud infrastructure through Google Cloud.

nodes.name: Amazon
nodes.description: Amazon (AWS) has committed up to $4 billion to Anthropic, making it Anthropic's primary cloud and distribution partner. They offer Claude models through AWS Bedrock.

nodes.name: Dario Amodei
nodes.description: Dario Amodei is the co-founder and CEO of Anthropic. Previously he was VP of Research at OpenAI. He holds a PhD in computational neuroscience from Princeton.

nodes.name: Daniela Amodei
nodes.description: Daniela Amodei is the co-founder and President of Anthropic, responsible for business operations and growth. She previously led business development at OpenAI and Stripe.

nodes.name: Sam Altman
nodes.description: Sam Altman is the CEO of OpenAI. He was previously president of Y Combinator. He was briefly ousted in November 2023 but reinstated within days after staff revolt.

nodes.name: Demis Hassabis
nodes.description: Demis Hassabis is the co-founder and CEO of Google DeepMind. He co-founded DeepMind in 2010, which Google acquired in 2014. He led teams that created AlphaGo and AlphaFold.

metadata.education: Cambridge Computer Science, UCL Neuroscience PhD

nodes.name: Yann LeCun
nodes.description: Yann LeCun is the Chief AI Scientist at Meta AI. He is a Turing Award winner and pioneer of convolutional neural networks (CNNs). He is a strong critic of current LLM limitations.

nodes.name: Ilya Sutskever
nodes.description: Ilya Sutskever is a co-founder of OpenAI and was its Chief Scientist until 2024. He then founded Safe Superintelligence Inc (SSI) with a focus on building safe AGI.

metadata.education: University of Toronto PhD under Hinton

nodes.name: Arthur Mensch
nodes.description: Arthur Mensch is the CEO and co-founder of Mistral AI. He previously worked as a research scientist at Google DeepMind on large language model training.

nodes.name: Aidan Gomez
nodes.description: Aidan Gomez is the CEO and co-founder of Cohere. He is a co-author of the original 'Attention Is All You Need' transformer paper published while interning at Google Brain.

nodes.name: Claude 3 Opus
nodes.description: Claude 3 Opus is Anthropic's most capable model in the Claude 3 family, excelling at complex reasoning, analysis, and nuanced instruction following. It surpassed GPT-4 on many benchmarks.

nodes.name: Claude 3 Sonnet
nodes.description: Claude 3 Sonnet is Anthropic's balanced model offering the best combination of speed and intelligence. It is used in the multi-agent synthesis step of this very pipeline.

nodes.name: GPT-4
nodes.description: GPT-4 is OpenAI's flagship large multimodal model, capable of processing both text and images. It demonstrated significant improvements in reasoning, coding, and complex task completion.

nodes.name: GPT-4o
nodes.description: GPT-4o (omni) is OpenAI's multimodal model that processes text, audio, and images in real-time. It replaced GPT-4 as the default ChatGPT model with faster speeds and lower cost.

nodes.name: Gemini 1.5 Ultra
nodes.description: Gemini 1.5 Ultra is Google DeepMind's most capable model with a 1 million token context window. It uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture and natively processes text, images, audio, and video.

nodes.name: Llama 3
nodes.description: Llama 3 is Meta AI's open-weight large language model family (8B, 70B, 405B parameters). It is freely available for research and commercial use, making it the most popular open-source LLM.

nodes.name: Mistral 7B
nodes.description: Mistral 7B is Mistral AI's foundational open-source model with 7 billion parameters. Despite its small size, it outperforms Llama 2 13B on many benchmarks through sliding window attention.

nodes.name: Command R+
nodes.description: Command R+ is Cohere's enterprise-grade model optimized for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and tool use. It supports 10 languages and 128K context for business applications.

nodes.name: Transformer Architecture
nodes.description: The Transformer architecture introduced in 'Attention Is All You Need' (2017) by Vaswani et al. is the foundation of virtually all modern LLMs. It uses self-attention mechanisms instead of recurrent layers.

nodes.name: ChatGPT
nodes.description: ChatGPT is OpenAI's conversational AI assistant launched in November 2022. It reached 100 million users in 2 months and is now used by over 100 million weekly active users globally.

nodes.name: Claude.ai
nodes.description: Claude.ai is Anthropic's consumer-facing AI assistant available at claude.ai. It provides access to Claude models for chat, document analysis, coding, and creative tasks.

nodes.name: Gemini App
nodes.description: Gemini is Google's AI assistant app (formerly Bard) powered by Gemini models. It integrates with Google Workspace including Gmail, Docs, and Search.

nodes.name: Le Chat
nodes.description: Le Chat is Mistral AI's conversational assistant platform. It showcases Mistral's models and competes in the consumer AI assistant space, with a focus on European users.

nodes.name: Safe Superintelligence Inc (SSI)
nodes.description: Safe Superintelligence Inc (SSI) is an AI safety startup founded by Ilya Sutskever after leaving OpenAI. Its singular focus is on building safe superintelligent AI.

edges.description: Dario Amodei co-founded and serves as CEO of Anthropic, setting the company's research direction and safety mission.
Daniela Amodei co-founded Anthropic and serves as its President, overseeing business operations and growth.
Dario Amodei was VP of Research at OpenAI before leaving to co-found Anthropic in 2021.
Daniela Amodei worked in business development at OpenAI before co-founding Anthropic in 2021.
Sam Altman is the CEO of OpenAI, driving its mission of developing safe and beneficial AGI.
Demis Hassabis co-founded DeepMind and now leads Google DeepMind as its CEO after Google's acquisition.
Yann LeCun serves as Chief AI Scientist at Meta AI, directing fundamental AI research.
Ilya Sutskever co-founded OpenAI in 2015 and served as Chief Scientist until departing in 2024.
Ilya Sutskever founded Safe Superintelligence Inc (SSI) in 2024 after leaving OpenAI, with $1B in funding.
Arthur Mensch co-founded and serves as CEO of Mistral AI, leading model development and commercialization.
Arthur Mensch worked as a research scientist at Google DeepMind on LLM training before founding Mistral AI.
Aidan Gomez co-founded and serves as CEO of Cohere, building enterprise NLP solutions.
Aidan Gomez is a co-author of 'Attention Is All You Need', the seminal paper introducing the Transformer architecture.
Anthropic developed Claude 3 Opus, their most capable model released in March 2024.
Anthropic developed Claude 3 Sonnet as the balanced speed-intelligence model in the Claude 3 family.
OpenAI developed GPT-4, released in March 2023, as their flagship large language model.
OpenAI developed GPT-4o (omni), released in May 2024, as a faster and cheaper multimodal replacement for GPT-4.
OpenAI created ChatGPT, launched November 2022, which became the fastest-growing consumer app in history.
Google DeepMind developed Gemini 1.5 Ultra with a 1 million token context window.
Google DeepMind powers the Gemini assistant app (formerly Bard).
Meta AI developed Llama 3, releasing it as open-weight models available for commercial use.
Mistral AI developed Mistral 7B and released it as open-source under Apache 2.0 license.
Mistral AI created Le Chat as their consumer AI assistant powered by Mistral models.
Cohere developed Command R+ optimized for enterprise RAG applications with 128K context.
Anthropic created Claude.ai, their consumer AI assistant platform.
Microsoft has invested over $13 billion in OpenAI and is its primary cloud provider through Azure OpenAI Service.
Google has invested $2 billion in Anthropic and is a strategic cloud partner through Google Cloud.
Amazon has committed up to $4 billion to Anthropic and distributes Claude models through AWS Bedrock.
Google (Alphabet) owns Google DeepMind, having acquired DeepMind in 2014 for $500M and merged it with Google Brain in 2023.
ChatGPT Plus is powered by GPT-4 and GPT-4o, offering access to OpenAI's most capable models.
ChatGPT default tier uses GPT-4o as its primary model since May 2024.
Claude.ai Pro tier uses Claude 3 Opus as its most capable model for complex tasks.
Claude.ai uses Claude 3 Sonnet as the default model for balanced performance.
Gemini Advanced is powered by Gemini 1.5 Ultra, Google's most capable model.
Le Chat is powered by Mistral AI models including Mistral 7B and Mixtral variants.
GPT-4 is built on the Transformer architecture, using decoder-only transformer blocks with modifications.
Claude 3 Opus uses a transformer-based architecture with Anthropic's Constitutional AI training methodology.
Gemini Ultra uses a transformer-based Mixture-of-Experts architecture for efficient scaling.
Llama 3 is a decoder-only transformer model using grouped-query attention for efficiency.
Mistral 7B uses a transformer architecture with sliding window attention and grouped-query attention.
Anthropic directly competes with OpenAI in the AI assistant and API market, with Claude vs ChatGPT.
OpenAI competes with Google DeepMind, with GPT-4 vs Gemini being the primary rivalry.
Anthropic has a strategic partnership with Amazon: AWS provides compute, and Claude is available on Bedrock.
Anthropic partnered with Google Cloud for training compute and distribution, alongside Google's $2B investment.
OpenAI is deeply partnered with Microsoft: Azure hosts their workloads and Microsoft integrates OpenAI APIs across products.
Hugging Face hosts Llama 3 model weights and enables easy download and fine-tuning by the community.
Hugging Face hosts Mistral 7B and its variants, making them accessible to the open-source community.
